_about: Learned parameters for the Indian Cove nowcast. Produced by the microclimate study (Phase 1/2), consumed by nowcast.py -> nowcast.json -> the board. Bias offsets fill in as join_log.csv accumulates real rain events; everything else is seeded from the Phase 1 measurements.
generated_note: seed built 2026-08-24 from phase1 beam/blockage run

radar.why: Both NEXRADs overshoot ~a mile over the cove (KATX 5661 ft @103 km, KLGX 4646 ft @92 km; measured blockage 0% / 14%). Low-level rain is invisible. Direct radar/MRMS reflectivity is near-useless here and must be down-weighted; model + surface obs carry the nowcast.

stations.precip_gauges_note: Synoptic rain gauges near the cove, closest first. G2160 = Fair Harbor Marina, Grapeview (~4.5 mi up Case Inlet) -- the closest gauge, reports precip_accum_since_local_midnight. Tipping bucket under-catches light drizzle, so absence is not proof of dry. Requires SYNOPTIC_TOKEN env (GitHub secret); falls back to keyless METAR when absent.

bias_offsets._status: awaiting rain events in join_log.csv; null = use raw value

stations.upwind_note: Per regime (wind_regimes[].upwind): stations UPWIND of the cove for that flow -- leading indicators for rain inbound. Bearings from cove: KSHN WSW, KOLM S, KTIW E, KTCM ESE, KPWT NNE. NW flow is data-sparse (Olympics/Hood Canal), so post-frontal-NW upwind is weak.

wind_regimes.name: frontal-SW
wind_regimes.note: onshore SW flow -- systems arrive from here

wind_regimes.name: pre-frontal-S
wind_regimes.note: veering ahead of a front, rain increasing

wind_regimes.name: post-frontal-NW
wind_regimes.note: showery, but convergence usually parks north of us

baro.note: surface pressure tendency (Open-Meteo pressure_msl or Tacoma PORTS). Falling fast => system inbound; boosts wet confidence.

blend._about: Crossfade from obs-extrapolation to model as lead time grows. weights sum ~1 across {minutely, hourly, regime}.

wind_shelter._about: Local wind = free-stream (forecast) speed x factor, per regime, per point; direction rotates by dir_shift deg. Factor = local speed / open-water free-stream. Look up by the wind_regimes[].name that the forecast direction falls in.
wind_shelter._method: WindNinja 3.12.2 on a fine custom landscape (windninja/cove_landscape.lcp, 5 m, built from 1 m LIDAR DTM+canopy). STRONG winds: momentum/CFD solver (OpenFOAM RANS) -- resolves the cliff-lee eddy that mass-conservation misses. LIGHT calm nights: mass-conserving + diurnal slope-flow + non-neutral stability -- cold-air drainage/pooling. Supersedes the earlier 30 m LANDFIRE mass-solver seed.

stable_night._about: Clear calm winter pre-dawn (05:00, 0 cloud, 3 kt ambient offshore). stable_kt = near-surface wind; the marina is nearly calm (~2 kt) and the drainage deepens it below the neutral baseline while exposed shores hold ~3.5 kt. stable_dir = direction the flow comes from (deg).

wind_shelter.notes: post-frontal-NW HarstinePointe_SW factor 1.54 is a terrain-gap/edge speedup with high CFD uncertainty -- treat as 'exposed/accelerated', not a precise value.
wind_shelter._speed_independent: Validated speed-independent: CFD at 15 vs 30 kt changed the marina factor by <=0.02 (mean |d|=0.004, max any point 0.05). So a single factor per regime applies at all strong-wind speeds; no speed axis needed. local = regional_kt x factor.
wind_shelter.solver: momentum: OpenFOAM RANS 300 it, 15 m mesh, neutral; drainage: mass-conserving diurnal + non_neutral_stability, 15 m mesh

model_calibration.note: add temp_offset_f to model temp; multiply model precip by precip_ratio (rain shadow)
model_calibration.precip_ratio_source: Jarrell Cove CoCoRaHS (US1WAMS0032) vs Open-Meteo, 862 days -- accurate hand-gauge, supersedes G2160
